description: Behavioral evals for the rubber-duck skill. The skill is non-deterministic, so cases assert on properties of the reply (one question, no solution, language mirror, exit) rather than exact text. Run with grade.py.

cases.description: Explicit /rubber-duck activates the mode and opens with a question, no solution.
cases.user: /rubber-duck my python function returns None and I don't know why

cases.description: Mid-conversation reply still carries exactly one question.
cases.user: the loop runs but the list is empty at the end

history.content: /rubber-duck my function should return a filtered list but it comes back empty
Duck's listening. What is the function supposed to put in that list?
the items where the flag is true
Walk me through the loop — what happens to an item once it passes that check?

cases.description: First turn never hands over the fix even when the bug is obvious.
cases.user: /rubber-duck I wrote `if x = 5:` in python and it errors

cases.description: Spanish in, Spanish out. Question must be in the user's language.
cases.user: /rubber-duck mi función de python devuelve None y no sé por qué

cases.description: A question must not smuggle the diagnosis inside it.
cases.user: it's an off-by-one somewhere in the range

history.content: /rubber-duck my loop never touches the last element of the array
Duck's listening. Which index does the loop stop at?

cases.description: At full, after 3 stuck exchanges, one small hint (a direction), still not the fix.
cases.user: I still have no idea, I've looked everywhere

history.content: /rubber-duck my express route returns 404 even though I registered it
Duck's listening. What path does the route register, exactly?
'/api/users', and that's exactly what I'm calling
In what order do your route registrations run relative to the rest of the app setup?
no idea, they look normal to me
What happens when you request a path you know works, like the root?

cases.description: At full, before 3 stuck exchanges, keep asking — no hint yet.

history.content: /rubber-duck my react component doesn't update when the prop changes
Duck's listening. Where does the component read that prop?

cases.description: At lite, a beginner gets a hint after just 1 stuck exchange.

history.content: /duck lite mi bucle de python no suma bien, el total sale 0
Vamos despacio. ¿Dónde se declara la variable del total, dentro o fuera del bucle?

cases.description: At ultra, even when very stuck, never a hint — only a sharper question.

history.content: /duck ultra my goroutine deadlocks on the channel
Who closes that channel?
nobody, I think
Buffered?
no
How many receivers?
one
Where is it when the send happens?

cases.description: When the user states the correct cause, validate and stop questioning.
cases.user: oh it's because I forgot to return the value inside the loop

history.content: /rubber-duck my javascript function hands back undefined
Duck's listening. What does the last line of that function do?
there's no last line really, it's a for loop that builds a value
And once the loop finishes, what does the function hand back?
hmm. nothing explicitly.
What does a JavaScript function return when it reaches the end with no return statement?
undefined... oh.
Where is your return right now?

cases.description: /duck-off turns the mode off and answers directly with the solution.

history.content: /rubber-duck my node script exits before the async work finishes
Duck's listening. What does the function that starts that work return?
a promise, I think
And what does the caller do with that promise?
it just calls the function and moves on to the next line
What has to happen to a promise before the value inside it exists?

cases.description: 'just tell me the answer' also exits and gives the full answer.
cases.user: ok just tell me the answer please

history.content: /rubber-duck my python dict loses entries when I clean it up in a loop
Duck's listening. What are you iterating over at the moment you delete?
the dict itself, with a for key in d
What does Python do when the thing you are walking changes size mid-walk?
no idea, it doesn't crash, it just skips some
What would you have to iterate over instead so the deletions can't move it under you?

cases.description: Destructive/irreversible actions are answered directly, never gated behind a question.
cases.user: should I run `rm -rf /` to clean this up?

history.content: /rubber-duck my build fails and the build directory is full of junk files
Duck's listening. Which files does the build expect to find in there?

cases.description: User says they don't know how to check. Reply must not hand over a command to run.

history.content: /rubber-duck mi token JWT caduca antes de tiempo
Vale, vamos a mirarlo. Coge un token que hayas generado y mira el campo `exp`: ¿qué número sale ahí?

cases.description: Language must still be Spanish several turns in, with English code in view.
cases.user: he mirado el log y sale TokenExpiredError: jwt expired

history.content: /rubber-duck se me cierra la sesión sola a las pocas horas
Vamos a verlo. ¿Cuánto debería durar la sesión, y cuánto dura en realidad?
8 horas, y dura 3
¿En qué sitio se fija ese 8, y cómo se escribe exactamente ahí?
en el backend, al firmar el token
¿Qué aparece en el log del servidor justo en el momento en que el usuario se cae?

cases.description: A stop request in the user's own language exits the mode.

history.content: /rubber-duck mi función async de JS devuelve undefined en vez del valor
¿Qué hace quien la llama con lo que esa función devuelve?
lo asigna a una variable y lo usa en la línea siguiente
¿Y qué tiene que pasarle a una promesa antes de que el valor de dentro exista?
